Context: 12. Annual reports regarding representation

## 12. Annual reports regarding representation  
The Ministries/Departments shall continue to upload data·on represen tation of Persons with Benchmark Disabilities along with data on SCs, STs, OB Cs in respect of posts/ services under the Central Government on the URL  
i.e. www.rrcps.nic.in as on 1st January of every year. All Ministries/Departments have been provided respective user code and password with guidelines for operating the URL.
